title: Druqks Subterror
prompt: aphex twin style from the druqks album
description: A subterranean drill and bass workout built on a thunderous LinnDrum with dense Euclidean kick patterns and stuttering, degraded hi-hat rolls that multiply and fragment as the track gains momentum. A square-wave sub-bass stalks through the low end the whole way, its filter slowly crawling open, while a breakdown section drowns the snare in cavernous delay before the full engine roars back.
code:
setcpm(165/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*8").s("square").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(180, 900)).resonance(8).decay(0.14).sustain(0.1).gain(0.95),
    s("bd(3,8)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.0),
    s("[~ hh]*2").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).degradeBy(0.3)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*8").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(220, 1400)).resonance(10).decay(0.12).sustain(0.1).gain(1.0),
    s("bd(5,8)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.05),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.85),
    s("hh*8").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.55).ply("<1 1 2 4>").degradeBy(0.25).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)),
    s("sd(7,16)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).speed(1.4).degradeBy(0.5).cut(1)
  )],
  [36, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0 c1 ab0 bb0 g0>*8").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(6).range(260, 1900)).resonance(11).decay(0.11).sustain(0.08).gain(1.05),
    s("bd(5,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.1),
    s("~ sd ~ [sd sd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.9).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("hh*16").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).ply("<2 1 4 2>").degradeBy(0.3).pan(sine.fast(2).range(0.25, 0.75)).cut(2),
    s("sd(9,16)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.62).speed(1.6).degradeBy(0.55).cut(1),
    s("oh ~ oh ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.45).degradeBy(0.4)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<c1 eb1 g0 ab0>*4").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(160, 700)).resonance(9).decay(0.2).sustain(0.2).gain(0.9).room(0.4),
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.95).room(0.3),
    s("~ sd").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.7).delay(".6:.166:.7").room(0.5),
    s("hh*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.4).delay(".5:.125:.6").degradeBy(0.4)
  )],
  [40, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0 c1 ab0 bb0 f0>*8").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(4).range(300, 2400)).resonance(12).decay(0.1).sustain(0.06).gain(1.1),
    s("bd(5,8,2)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.15),
    s("~ sd ~ [sd sd sd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.92).every(2, x => x.ply("<1 2>")),
    s("hh*16").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.52).ply("<2 4 2 8>").degradeBy(0.28).pan(sine.fast(3).range(0.2, 0.8)).cut(2),
    s("sd(11,16)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.64).speed(1.8).degradeBy(0.5).cut(1),
    s("oh(3,8)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.42).degradeBy(0.35),
    s("cp ~ ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.55).room(0.25).every(4, x => x.ply(4))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*8").s("square").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(900, 180)).resonance(8).decay(0.14).sustain(0.1).gain(0.9),
    s("bd(3,8)").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.95),
    s("[~ hh]*2").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.45).degradeBy(0.4).delay(".5:.125:.5")
  )]
)
